new_primary_work.difference: The earlier specialist module gave general guidance on fragmented decisions. The actual Dodd/Harper votes on issue versus disposition and their tested consequences in the later litigation were absent. These are now reconstructed directly from the two printed pages.

The upstream module mentions the dog briefly. The X-ray variation, unchanged public-setting and no-interference premises, rival treatment, qualified rule, and three separate replies in the Reasoner essay example were absent. These make the disagreement answerable as a worked chain.

The earlier module gives motive-chain and testimonial cautions. The figures in the Able case, the defense theory of the delivered disclosure with a signed blank check, use of prior returns for both sides, and Thompson’s testimony on the contested phrase furnish further reasoning material from the original.

The option analysis was present in the specialist upstream but absent as a fully taught interpretive problem in the prior lecture reference. It now distinguishes breach with effective revocation and an actually preserved power of acceptance.
